items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: When I went to the University of Alabama and I went to hear Earl Hines, they kicked me out.

ctx.x: But you were accepted because you were a player?
Yeah. And no one bothered me. When I went to the University of Alabama and I went to hear Earl Hines, they kicked me out. They says you ain’t got no business being here, get out. Cops.
